title: Nourishing Smoky Polish Ackee Wrap
description: A shaggy, comforting Polish dish featuring ackee, grilled to perfection and wrapped in a pandan leaf. This vegan-friendly breakfast wrap is a perfect way to start your day.

ingredients.name: polish sausage
ingredients.notes: grilled and sliced (optional) for non-vegan option

instructions: Preheat a yakimono-grill to medium-high heat.
Grill the polish sausage until cooked through, then slice into thin strips.
In a large bowl, combine diced ackee, grainy mustard, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the grilled sausage to the bowl and stir to combine.
Warm the pandan leaves by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Spoon the ackee mixture onto the center of a warmed pandan leaf, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Add a dollop of vegan mayo on top of the ackee mixture.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and pitted dates.
Fold the bottom edge of the pandan leaf up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a snug cylinder.
